summary: The reconciler re-checks every settled item in a full pass once every half hour instead of every minute or so. It wakes for a full pass only when one is due, and the profile notes each full pass and each correction one makes

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Incremental passes are unchanged. An item an incremental pass would miss is now corrected within half an hour instead of a minute; none was corrected in a day on a large node.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the minute's spacing.
